How It Works
Our 4-Step Process
Data Sweep
We must first start with clean data. Our meticulous data sweeping process curates datasets to identify goldmine leads. No more wasting time on irrelevant prospects.
Ideal Customer Profile Deep Dive
We don't deliver leads. We deliver perfect matches for your products or services. Let's get a crystal-clear picture of your perfect customer.
Ultra-Leveraged Multi-Channel Campaigns
Instead of casting a wide net, let's focus only on the most promising leads. By combining both new and old-school marketing tactics, we'll reach your audience wherever they are.
Campaign Refinement with A/B Testing
We constantly fine-tune your campaigns to optimize your lead generation efforts. The result? A steady stream of leads better than the last batch to keep your sales pipeline growing.
Proudly Partnered With
Who You're Working With
About Our Founder
Matt Bauman
Chief Lead Officer
I know what it takes to find good leads.
In March, 2020, during the heat of the COVID pandemic, I was a sales rep for a young marketing agency.
I'll never forget those days.
I was sending DM's on Instagram. Cold calling businesses I found on Google Maps. And driving 30 miles to knock on doors.
I did whatever it took to find a business owner who would happily pay for our services.
That's a good lead.
Whenever I managed to find a lead like that, closing the sale was easy.
After I finally found the first good lead, it only took me 6 months to become the top-earning sales rep.
I was offered the position of Director of Sales. They wanted me to turn new sales reps into closers.
But all I could think about was getting them good leads...
Here's why good leads matter.
No matter how much effort you put in as a sales rep, you'll always suffer if your pipeline is dry.
After hiring about a dozen or so B2B lead generation agencies, you know what I learned?
It's easy to promise 'qualified leads' and 'guaranteed booked appointments.'
The truth is, the best leads aren't "generated."
The best leads are attracted.
I started Chief Lead Officer to create custom strategies that attract B2B leads thrilled to discover your services.
